name: Maine

sen_prev.note: First-round (municipal) tally. Collins won a majority (50.98%) in round 1, so no ranked-choice tabulation was run. other = Lisa Savage (I) 40,579 + Max Linn (I) 13,508 + scattered write-ins 228.

not_in_units.note: STATE UOCAVA (statewide-only overseas/military ballots; county sums + this = statewide)

notes: Maine reports municipal results plus a statewide-only 'STATE UOCAVA' line (overseas/military ballots cast with the state, not assignable to a municipality or county). County sums therefore fall short of the statewide totals by exactly that line: pres2024 dem 5310, rep 986, other 273, total 6569 (ballots 6589); sen_prev dem 4068, rep 1089, other 491, total 5648 (ballots 5771); turnout2022 ballots 1845.

2022 Governor tabulation lists 'T3 ND Twp' (4 ballots) with county code PEN although it is a Hancock County township (coded HAN in the 2020 and 2024 files) and the SOS Hancock subtotal includes it; it is counted in Hancock (23009) here, matching the SOS county subtotals.

The 2024 municipal file first posted (also archived at lldc.mainelegislature.org .../2024/20241105/elec_20241105a.xlsx) had Harris 435,351 and Trump 377,837 (total 830,989); the Secretary of State corrected it on 2024-12-05 to the certified figures used here (Harris 435,652, Trump 377,977, total 831,375).
